description:
Apply a critical bug fix patch to the 'RadiationTherapy' project. A senior physicist has sent a patch file ('physics_fix.patch') located on your Desktop. This patch fixes a Monitor Unit calculation error in 'DoseCalculator.java' (adding Inverse Square Law correction) and updates daily calibration factors in 'CalibrationConstants.java'.

Your task:
1. Open the 'RadiationTherapy' project in Eclipse (it is already in your workspace).
2. Use the 'Team > Apply Patch' wizard to apply '~/Desktop/physics_fix.patch' to the project.
3. Ensure the patch is applied to the correct files.
4. Run the 'DoseTest' JUnit test (src/test/java/com/med/physics/DoseTest.java) to verify the fix works (it should pass with a green bar).
5. Save all changes.
